items.title: Tehran selling deal with US as victory – but for Iranians it was necessity
items.description: For many Iranians, the question is not whether the deal means victory, but whether it lowers prices and reduces fear of another war.

items.title: Fragile quiet in Lebanon as US-Iran truce leaves unanswered questions
items.description: Many Lebanese remain doubtful that the agreement could finally mean the end of the fighting between Israel and Hezbollah.

items.title: UK investigating reports Russian warship fired warning shots near yacht in English Channel
items.description: The retired couple tell BBC Newsnight they tried to show the warship they had changed course before the shots were fired.

items.title: Russian artist and Putin critic shot dead in Poland
items.description: Robert Kuzovkov, who used the pseudonym Semyon Skrepetsky, has been known for his caricatures of politicians including Vladimir Putin.

items.title: German broadcaster removes TV intro after Elon Musk takes legal action
items.description: ZDF TV responded to a "cease and desist" letter after the tech trillionaire condemned the broadcaster's "outrageous lies".

items.title: Hundreds of cats stolen for food in Vietnam rescued by police, welfare group says
items.description: Police have arrested nine people and rescued more than 400 cats destined for slaughter, with more than 40 reunited with their owners.

items.title: France's oldest female detainee, 79, goes on trial for in-law's grisly murder
items.description: A dismembered body found in a chain-bound trunk in the Seine in 1995 was only recently connected to the defendant by DNA evidence.

items.title: Venezuela signs deal with US energy giant to rebuild power grid
items.description: The deal with General Electric is the latest sign of co-operation between US firms and Venezuela's interim government.

items.title: Eight dead after US Air Force B-52 bomber crashes in California
items.description: The incident occurred on Monday morning while the aircraft had been on a routine test mission.

items.title: 'Dancing girl's' bare torso restored in Indian textbook after backlash
items.description: A picture in a new school textbook had covered up the naked torso of the famous figurine with dark shading.

items.title: Swedish man jailed for four years for coercing wife into sex with 120 men
items.description: The 61-year-old was found to have coerced his wife into sexual acts with men he found online in exchange for payment.

items.title: Cuba tourism collapses as US pressure campaign bites
items.description: The number of foreign visitors is down by 58% compared to last year, Cuban officials say, amid sanctions and an effective oil blockade.
